adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials);` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists `key` via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) returns the *Zod safeParse result object* (`{ success, data, error? }`), not `data` (it never unwraps `refreshTokenResponse.data`). Therefore the Prisma update will store the wrapper object instead of the credential payload. This is independent of sync being enabled/disabled because both branches use `schema.safeParse(...)`/`minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(...)` and return the safeParse result.
